ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Brand Designer to join our Design Team (working with DevRel, Success, and Enterprise) and help shape our visual storytelling across a variety of mediums. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, helping us bring our ideas to life with compelling visuals that engage our developer community and amplify our brand at conferences, events, swag, and beyond.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. You will have opportunities to lead, propose, and execute projects across various formats—from polished presentations to impactful print designs—ensuring a cohesive and powerful brand presence across all touchpoints.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Shape our visual storytelling across decks, printed materials, YouTube content, and conference assets.

 - Collaborate with Marketing, DevRel, Success, Enterprise, and Event teams to bring creative ideas to life.

 - Craft cohesive and engaging visual narratives for presentations, digital assets, and physical materials.

 - Maintain strict brand consistency, ensuring all materials adhere to Supabase’s visual identity and messaging.

 - Execute end-to-end design projects across multiple channels, including print, video, and social media.

 - Set high standards for design quality, meticulous attention to detail, and visual communication that resonates with our community.




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have strong proficiency in design tools like Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), and presentation software.

 - Are comfortable designing across digital, print, and video formats (and know the difference between 300gsm and 100gsm paper).

 - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams.

 - Are energized by creative storytelling and building an impactful, memorable brand presence for a developer audience.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and proactively bringing new ideas to the table.

 - Balance iteration and scale: You focus on high-impact, incremental improvements rather than a "redo everything" approach, and you welcome collaborative feedback.





WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Designer at Supabase, you'll be a key member of our design team, crafting innovative and user-focused solutions for our open-source database platform. You'll collaborate closely with Product Engineers, Product Managers, Product Marketing Managers and other peer designers to take ideas from idea to completion, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience across all Supabase products.

Your work will directly impact the developer community, making databases more accessible, powerful, and easy to use. You'll shape how developers experience Supabase at every touchpoint, driving clarity, usability, and craft across the entire product.

You'll have opportunities to lead, propose, and execute projects across various products and tools. Whether simplifying complex workflows, designing new features, improving onboarding, or elevating the overall product experience, your contributions will shape our platform's future.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Aligning teams with working prototypes, user flows, or high-fidelity mockups, choosing the most effective communication method.

 - Anticipating potential pitfalls ahead of time and improving usability to resolve them.

 - Leading complex design challenges, with the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals.

 - Finding alignment with cross-functional teams, along with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Success Engineers, Sales, Product Engineers, Product Marketing Managers, and other stakeholders.

 - Conducting or applying user research, gathering feedback, and using data to inform and validate design decisions.

 - Contributing to the overall product ecosystem, ensuring consistency and scalability across a growing product surface. You’ll be solving multiple problems at once by creating product primitives that can be reused, extended, and combined in different contexts.




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Prototype and show ideas rather than talk about them.

 - Prefer to collaboratively work with others that have different skill sets and possess different points of view.

 - Are actively building things outside of work; side projects, personal experiments; you're curious and you ship.

 - Can move fast without sacrificing craft. You balance quality with speed and know when good enough is good enough

 - Have high standards for design quality and user experience.

 - Can write code (with AI), and should be comfortable designing for a technical audience.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

04d1112669f07330.title: Senior Design Engineer
04d1112669f07330.jd:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Marketing team shapes how the world sees and experiences Attio. We think strategically, move fast, and obsess over quality — from acquisition to brand to product marketing. We experiment constantly, craft clear narratives, and focus relentlessly on what drives growth.

This role sits within Studio — Attio’s multidisciplinary team of creatives and design engineers. Working closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, and teams across the business, Studio operates as our in-house creative team, bringing ideas to life across campaigns, product launches, web experiences, and our broader brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer to own one of Attio’s most important products: our marketing website.

You’ll sit at the intersection of design and engineering, partnering closely with Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth to design, build, and evolve a world-class web experience that reflects the quality of our product and brand. From launching new product experiences and campaigns to refining interactions, performance, and accessibility, you’ll play a pivotal role in how customers experience Attio.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role suited to someone who combines exceptional frontend engineering with outstanding design craft. You’ll be responsible for delivering pixel-perfect experiences, leading complex website projects from concept to launch, and continuously raising the quality, scalability, and sophistication of our marketing platform as Attio continues to grow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the Marketing Website: Take end-to-end ownership of Attio’s marketing website, ensuring it remains fast, beautiful, and technically excellent while continuously evolving alongside our brand, product, and business.

Build Exceptional Web Experiences: Translate high-fidelity designs into polished, performant, and accessible user experiences using modern frontend technologies including TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Motion. You’ll obsess over the details, ensuring every interaction feels thoughtful across every device.

Partner Across Marketing: Collaborate closely with teammates across Studio, Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth to bring ambitious creative concepts to life, contributing to layout, interaction design, animation, typography, and visual polish while helping shape the final user experience.

Lead Complex Website Projects: Own the technical delivery of major website initiatives from concept through to launch, balancing creativity with pragmatism while providing clear direction on feasibility, timelines, and implementation.

Evolve Our Frontend Platform: Continuously improve the architecture, tooling, and maintainability of our marketing stack, helping us move faster without compromising quality as the website grows in scale and complexity.

Raise the Engineering Bar: Champion exceptional engineering standards through clean, maintainable code, thoughtful technical decisions, and mentorship of other Design Engineers as the team continues to grow.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Exceptional Frontend Craft: Significant experience building high-quality, production-ready websites using a modern stack that includes TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Motion. You care deeply about performance, accessibility, maintainability, and implementation quality.

A Strong Design Eye: Outstanding visual taste with the ability to interpret design systems, typography, spacing, animation, and layout to an exceptionally high standard. You’re comfortable working directly in Figma and making thoughtful design decisions where needed.

Systems Thinking: Experience designing scalable website architecture, design systems, and workflows that enable teams to build quickly while maintaining consistency, quality, and long-term maintainability.

End-to-End Ownership: A proven track record of leading website projects from concept through delivery, coordinating stakeholders, balancing technical constraints with creative ambition, and consistently delivering high-quality outcomes.

Excellent Product Judgement: Strong instincts for user experience, interaction design, and web best practices, with the ability to balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and business objectives.

Collaborative Leadership: An excellent communicator who enjoys partnering with designers, marketers, and engineers alike. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a high bar for quality, while helping elevate the people and work around you.




WHAT DOES THE HIRING PROCESS LOOK LIKE?

 - Initial conversations
   
   - 30-minute intro with a member of our Talent team
   
   - 30-minute track record interview with our Campaigns Lead

 - Core interviews
   
   - A series of collaborative working sessions exploring your technical craft, design and engineering approach, problem-solving, collaboration, and overall alignment with Attio’s culture, values, and ways of working.

 - Final stage
   
   - 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our leadership team
   
   - Offer call (if it's a mutual fit)

f62eb5a97ddb4d3e.title: Design Engineer - EU
f62eb5a97ddb4d3e.location: Portugal, Spain, Italy, Switzerland, Croatia, Ireland, Stockholm, Romania, Barcelona, Berlin, Sweden, Estonia
f62eb5a97ddb4d3e.jd:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhikpramanik/, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

 - Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

 - Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

 - Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

 - You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

 - This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

 - You get to shape the UI and UX of a powerful and complex product. Our users need software that helps them move quickly while adapting to their unique workflows and preferences. As a result, our UI isn’t a simple chatbox, but it can’t rely on a sea of knobs and dials either. It needs to feel approachable to someone using it for the first time while offering increasingly powerful ways to customize and automate their work.

 


WHY YOU SHOULDN’T APPLY

Design Engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some reasons you might not enjoy the role:

 - You only want to work on design systems. While improving our design system is one of many responsibilities, you won’t be able to work on it exclusively.

 - You like to do extensive research and user testing before implementation. The beauty of being part-Engineer is that you can build conviction by shipping to a subset of users (including our own team) and gathering feedback!

 - You want everything to be perfect before it gets into a user’s hands. One of the drivers of our success is that we ship fast. While we appreciate the strive for perfection, we also realize it doesn’t need to be achieved all at once; instead, we iterate over time, often letting user feedback and business needs drive prioritization.

 - You don’t have excellent taste and execution in visual design. Design Engineers set the bar for visual design in our app and continually improve it, pushing its boundaries with each new feature or redesign.

 - You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the design and technical details.

 - You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.

 


WHAT SENIORITY/LEVEL TO APPLY FOR

We’ve posted levels from Junior to Staff. The higher the level, the more experience and alignment with the role we expect when reviewing your application and while interviewing. Please apply to the one that sets the right expectations.

 - Junior Design Engineer - You should have no more than 2 years of industry experience as a designer or engineer. We want to see projects (personal or professional) with at least a couple of users that showcase great visual taste and burgeoning talent in both UI/UX and Engineering.

 - Design Engineer (This Posting) - This posting covers both Mid and Senior levels. You have 2+ years of continuous experience (e.g., internships don’t count) as an Engineer or a Designer. You have good proficiency in both Design and Engineering, with exceptional proficiency in the discipline you practice full-time. Regardless of which discipline you’re coming from, we expect experience designing products and shipping code to hundreds of users (even if through side projects).

 - Staff Design Engineer - We’re looking for folks who’ve practiced our flavor of Design Engineering professionally. It may not be through a formal title, but you’ve made major contributions to a design system and designed and implemented features for hundreds of users and iterated on them through user feedback.

Internally, we do not use these titles, but Engineers are leveled based on proficiency (which you can read about here https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/engineering/leveling-and-compensation).

 


WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

As we’ve set the standard for excellence in TA software, HR teams have pulled us into solving their problems in areas like onboarding and performance management.

 


ENGINEERING CULTURE

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:

 - Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design

 - Natural collaboration and deliberate communication

 - Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage

 - Putting effort into building a diverse team

 


MINIMAL PROCESS & LOTS OF OWNERSHIP

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive.

 


COLLABORATION IS NATURAL & COMMUNICATION IS DELIBERATE

Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here https://www.ashbyhq.com/team!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/company/thoughtful-communication).

Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

 
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/4ea5f68e-c33e-4ac9-831a-e732bee4a303/d4679311-9dba-4031-bf5e-19ce78597ab1/calendar.png]
 

We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.

 


INCREASE LEVERAGE, NOT TEAM SIZE

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

 - Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.

 - Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).

THE ROLE



Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within +2 /-6 UTC.



As the Senior Manager, Product Design, you will lead, inspire, and scale a distributed team of Product Designers and UX Researchers. You will own the design vision for Oyster’s platform, ensuring our complex global employment workflows feel intuitive, seamless, AI-native, and deeply human.



A critical focus of this role will be pioneering our next-generation design workflows. You will champion the strategic adoption of AI within the design organization, optimizing how we research, prototype, and build, while guiding your team in architecting intuitive UI, Zero-UI, and agentic experiences for our customers.







KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Team Leadership & Scaling: Lead and scale a high-performing team of Product Designers and UX Researchers, fostering a culture of rigorous feedback, continuous learning, and psychological safety.

 - Talent Development: Define clear career ladders, provide actionable coaching, and elevate execution across both generative UX research methodologies and high-fidelity interaction design.

 - AI-Augmented Design Ops: Drive the internal adoption of emerging AI and automated tooling within the design lifecycle (e.g., AI-assisted prototyping, automated UI generation, and LLM-driven research synthesis) to exponentially maximize team velocity.

 - System Evolution: Modernize our Design Ops and scale our global design system to seamlessly integrate automated, intelligent tokenization and intelligent layout generation.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as a strategic peer to Engineering, Product, GTM, and Data/AI leaders to align UX strategy with business growth, data model capabilities, and technical feasibility.

 - Guardianship of Trust: Establish design principles for responsible AI, transparency, and data privacy, ensuring automated workflows maintain user trust in a high-stakes compliance environment.




CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - 8+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a proven portfolio of complex, data-heavy B2B SaaS or fintech environments.

 - 4+ years of formal people management experience, ideally leading distributed, multi-timezone teams.

 - AI Literacy: Deep, demonstrable curiosity and hands-on experience utilizing GenAI tooling to optimize product development workflows and systems.

 - Systems Thinker: Strong foundational knowledge in designing for non-linear user journeys, asynchronous AI states, and conversational/agentic interfaces.

 - [BONUS] Experience navigating compliance-heavy, highly regulated industries (Fintech, HRTech, LegalTech).

 - [BONUS] Experience mapping complex service blueprints where software and human service operations overlap harmoniously.




YOU'LL ALSO NEED

 - A reliable home internet connection (or be able to get one).

 - Fluent English language skills.
   
   




HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

9f8c98cd46b1560f.jd:
ABOUT YLABS  
  YLabs is a leading global design and research organization working to improve health and economic opportunity for young people aged 10–24. Founded in 2016 at the Harvard Innovation Lab, YLabs operates across Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, and Central America in partnership with youth to design products and services addressing key challenges in sexual reproductive health, HIV/AIDS, mental health, financial inclusion, and climate resilience.  
  THE ROLE  
  YLabs is seeking a Deputy Director of Design Research to lead its Deep Listening function and shape the organization- wide vision, methodology, and operational approach to user and ethnographic field research. This role is ideal for a seasoned design researcher who can seamlessly lead projects  from initial research ideation and ground-level field execution to insight synthesis and strategic presentations for C suite executives and senior stakeholders. They will establish institutional systems, develop frameworks across multiple teams, manage Institutional Review Board (IRB) processes, and direct field teams and local Principal Investigators (PIs) across complex regional contexts.  
  JOB TYPE  
  This is a full time position within the Design Department (Job Level: P6 - Deputy Director). The role is scoped for 40 hours per week and is ideally based in East Africa, though candidates within the GMT+0 to GMT+4 time zone on the African continent may also apply. Candidates must be willing to travel up to 50% of the time for field sprints and stakeholder alignment The initial contract term is 12 months, with the possibility of extension.  
  PAY RATE  
  The pay range for this position is   $48,500 - $72,143. This range is regionally benchmarked against the P6 level within YLabs’ Africa salary bands.  YLabs pays all full-time staff salaries in the local currency of the staff member’s permanent work location.   
  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
   Research Strategy & Systems Leadership  
 
  Inform and implement the strategic direction for research planning and execution ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and impact goals.  
  Build, scale, and standardize institutional systems, toolkits, and operational blueprints across multiple teams to support effective research ownership and execution.  
  Drive the synthesis of qualitative and quantitative insights across projects to inform high-level strategic decisions, program designs, and organizational growth.  
  Serve as an internal and external subject matter expert, advocating for the critical value of grounded, evidence-based design research.  
 
  IRB, Ethics & Governance Management  
 
  Provide end-to-end oversight and strategic guidance on all Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions, protocol adaptations, and ethics compliance in collaboration with YLabs Research team  
  Oversee the development of rigorous, ethically sound research protocols (including literature reviews, sampling strategies, and consent mechanisms) tailored to local review board requirements.  
  Manage recruitment and oversight of local Principal Investigators (PIs) to navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural nuances, and site approvals.  
  Support development of and ensure strict adherence to Human Subjects standards, global safeguarding policies, and data protection protocols across all field deployments.  
 
  End-to-End Field Execution & Methodological Direction  
 
  Design and lead rapid-cycle field research sprints utilizing immersive observation, semi-structured 1-on-1 interviews, and participatory focus group discussions.  
  Build and manage pipelines for recruiting and training local community researchers and youth field listeners.  
  Oversee t daily field debriefs, implement reflexivity and positionality checks, and mitigate researcher bias during in-person engagements.  
  Adapt research plans dynamically when facing unexpected field obstacles, security considerations, or shifting group dynamics.  
 
  Synthesis, Packaging & Senior Stakeholder Engagement  
 
  Translate raw, complex qualitative field data into structured analytical frameworks, including root-cause analyses, ecosystem maps, personas, and user journey maps.  
  Co-create and iterate insight narratives through participatory sense-making sessions with field teams and local community partners.  
  Synthesise and package research findings into high-impact executive summaries, deep-dive strategic reports, and compelling presentations for donors, C-suite executives, and senior leaders.  
  Translate youth-driven insights into actionable opportunity areas and strategic recommendations for innovation.  
 
  REQUIRED COMPETENCIES  
 
  Design Research & Mixed-Method Research Mastery:   Demonstrates mastery of design research, qualitative and quantitative synthesis, and ethnographic field methods, with proven success in managing multiple complex research projects simultaneously.  
  Autonomy & Strategic Leadership:   Requires no instruction on routine work and operates with complete autonomy on complex organizational initiatives. Makes high-impact strategic decisions independently.  
  IRB & Compliance Expertise:   Deep understanding of ethical research protocols, IRB application processes, informed consent procedures, and human subjects protection.  
  System Building & Prioritization:   Inherently displays best practices in delegation and team management, establishing systems and structures across teams to enable seamless research operations.  
  Adaptability & Complex Problem Solving:   Creatively shifts approaches when facing unexpected field obstacles; demonstrates best practices in navigating barriers and anticipating future challenges.

f55797700e4ac22a.title: Lead Product Designer
f55797700e4ac22a.jd: There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!        About This Role      As a Lead Product Designer at OutSystems, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of our low-code platform. You'll take ownership of delivering user-centered design solutions that address complex challenges and empower our customers to create software faster, smarter, and with greater impact.    In this role, you will drive design excellence across the product, ensuring every interaction and interface reflects OutSystems' commitment to quality and innovation. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Research teams, you will transform customer insights into intuitive and engaging product experiences that inspire confidence and drive adoption.   Increasingly, "the user" includes AI agents operating alongside humans, you don't need to design for that frontier yourself, but you'll need to recognize it when it shows up in your workflows and know when to loop in the team that does.    As a design lead, you will mentor and guide the designer you work with, fostering collaboration and a shared vision for design excellence. You'll help establish and uphold design standards, align with strategic goals, and ensure OutSystems delivers a product experience that stands out in the low-code market.      Key Responsibilities     Lead Design Processes:  Take ownership of user and product research, ideation sessions, end-to-end mockup solutions, and user testing, iterating on designs to deliver validated, impactful solutions.     Advocate for Design Excellence:  Champion product design practices across the Product and R&D organization, advocating for user-centric solutions and voicing the needs of our users to shape a better product.     Collaborate in an Agile Environment:  Partner with cross-functional teams to drive the design process from initial ideation through product delivery and launch, ensuring alignment and seamless execution.     Empathize with Developers:  Step into the developers' perspective to identify challenges and craft pragmatic, effective design solutions that integrate seamlessly with the development process.     Recognize Agent-Touched Workflows:  As AI agents take on more of the building and operating work on the platform, identify where a workflow you're designing is still human-only, where it's human-and-agent (co-navigation), and where it's shifting toward agent-led with human oversight, and loop in the AX practice when a workflow crosses that line.     Design Clear Human Oversight Moments:  For features where AI assistance or automation touches the user's task, ensure the human's moments of control, review, and override are simple, trustworthy, and never an afterthought.     Contribute to Practice Development:  Support the evolution of the UX practice,  including how it interfaces with the emerging AX (Agentic Experience) discipline,  and provide training to empower other teams in adopting design best practices.     Inspire and Motivate:  Bring energy, adaptability, and enthusiasm to the team, introducing innovative ideas and approaches that spark creativity and elevate the product design process.        What You Need To Succeed      5+ years of experience working in UX or Product Design.      Experience in leading projects ranging from planning, conducting research in user experience, running product design processes and testing solutions.      Experience working in cross-functional teams (e.g. design, engineering).      Ability to go from macro vision to implementation details in an iterative, highly collaborative and supported way.      Either a degree in a UX related field and professional experience with complex products (B2B SaaS preferred).      Experience working in the technology industry.      Working knowledge of how AI copilots, assistants, or agents are changing product experiences,  enough fluency to spot when a feature you're designing has an agent in the loop, and to have an informed conversation with AX and AI teams about it.      Familiarity with the UX - UAX - AX spectrum (human-navigated, human-and-agent co-navigated, and agent-autonomous experiences) as a way of framing where a given design problem sits.      Great communication skills, including the ability to explain human-centered design needs to technical and AI-focused stakeholders.      Fluent in Figma and other design tools; comfort with AI-assisted design tools (e.g. Figma Make, Cursor, Claude).      Fluent in English, both spoken and written.      Bonus: Knowledge of low-code platforms, software development processes, or related technical domains.        More about OutSystems   OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.     As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.     We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.      OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and  includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.     Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.      Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.        Working at OutSystems   Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems.     What do we have to offer you?    A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don’t just react to AI innovation—we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.    Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.    A global collective of world-class talent, where you’ll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries—they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together.       OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

dee27d5ed937e5d3.title: Senior Product Designer
dee27d5ed937e5d3.jd: RemoFirst  is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.  We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.   As a  Senior   Product Designer , you will play a vital role in crafting effective, intuitive, and delightful interfaces by deeply understanding stakeholder needs, conducting user and business research, and translating insights into user experiences our customers will love to use. You will be responsible for creating wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, with a strong focus on onboarding flows and seamless AI feature interactions. You will test your UX solutions with customers, define optimal navigation and interaction patterns, and ensure design consistency with our brand guidelines, usability standards, accessibility best practices, and performance requirements.    What you will be doing    User and Business Research and Analysis:   Conduct research and analyze user and business needs to create effective interfaces with a focus on onboarding journeys.   Gather and interpret user feedback and data to inform design decisions.  Collaborate with stakeholders to understand project objectives and target audience.   Wireframing, Layout, and Design:   Create wireframes, layouts, and designs that meet user requirements and business goals, with strong creativity in UI to enhance onboarding flows and AI feature interactions.  Adapt designs for various devices and screen sizes.  Ensure design adherence to UX/UI principles and best practices, particularly for highly engaging and intuitive interactions.   Prototyping and User Testing:   Develop interactive prototypes to test and validate design concepts with users.  Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to refine designs.  Analyze user data and incorporate insights into design iterations.   Navigation and Interaction Design:   Define optimal navigation flows and interactions for websites and applications.  Ensure seamless user experiences by considering information architecture and user journeys.   Design Consistency and Technical Requirements:   Maintain design consistency and adhere to technical requirements during the development process.  Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure design feasibility and implementation.    Requirements    Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a Product Designer, preferably with hands-on experience at tech startups, especially those with a heavy focus on UX.  A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered designs and successful projects.  Design Skills: Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools. Deep understanding of UX/UI design principles and the ability to create high-quality user interfaces.  Device Adaptation and Trends: Experience in adapting designs for various devices. Knowledge of UX/UI design trends and a strong desire to learn and grow in this field.  User Research and Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills, including conducting user research and analyzing data. Ability to gather insights and apply them to design solutions.     How you'll work    Proficiency in English  is a must.    Adept at cross-cultural communication:  Being a completely remote company, we’re working with people from different cultures across different time-zones. You will need to have a strong aptitude for proactive cross-cultural communication.   Systematic and Strong Time Management:  We have lots to achieve together as a team, and at times, you will need to be able to manage your time and priorities for yourself, and by yourself.   Knack for Design Thinking:  Our customers are at the heart of what we do. You will be expected to have a strong and empathetic approach to design thinking to deliver a stellar experience that our customers love to use.   Hyperlogical Problem-Solving : We’re moving and growing at a fast-pace, and that means being involved in solving complex problems. You will need to demonstrate a strong knack for first-principles, hyper-logical approach to solving problems and cutting through complexity.    Benefits     Startup environment:  RemoFirst is an early-stage startup. You have a voice that can influence, and grow rapidly. An opportunity to build a tech unicorn.    Growth opportunity:  This is a chance to join an AI-forward company driving innovation through artificial intelligence. As Product Designer, you’ll lead product initiatives that deliver strategic impact.   Direct impact:  Your work will be at the center of how we grow revenue, support customers, and differentiate in the market.   Autonomy and Accountability:  We value autonomy and accountability — there’s no bureaucracy or lengthy approval process. We prioritize speed and results to keep moving forward effectively.   Work for a Market Leader:  Scale a project that counts market-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.    Leadership visibility:  Reporting into the Head of Product which means your projects will be strategic and business-critical. Diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA.  As we grow and evolve, we welcome your input to help us define our culture further.

df23e418ad147021.title: Product Designer (Trading)
df23e418ad147021.jd: We’re building the next generation of TN Trader — a proprietary, React-based trading platform designed for the needs of global CFD and spread betting traders. As our Trading Product Designer, you will own the design of our most complex and technically demanding product surface: the trading interface itself.  This is not a generalist design role. You will be embedded within the Trading UIs and Execution vertical, working closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, and front-end engineers to design trade tickets, charting interfaces, order management systems, and the full range of real-time financial UI that traders depend on every day. You will be expected to understand the domain deeply — financial instruments, order types, execution flows, risk displays — and translate that complexity into clean, precise, and highly usable interfaces across different devices.  You will work within a shared Figma design system, upholding and extending it with the same care and rigour you bring to your own output. You’re the kind of designer who finds satisfaction in a perfectly crafted component, a flawless handoff, and a build that matches the design intent pixel for pixel.  This role is remote, with required occasional travel to London.     Who we are   Trade Nation is a global CFD and spread betting broker. We help traders make better decisions through clear market insights, transparent pricing and a fairer approach to trading.  Since 2014, we’ve grown into a market-leading, low-cost broker with our headquarters in London and offices across Europe, South Africa, Asia-Pacific, and key offshore regions including the Caribbean and Indian Ocean. Our platform is available in 14 languages, making it accessible to traders worldwide.  Built on transparency and trust, and driven by our people, our focus is simple: helping customers trade more effectively. We do that by keeping costs low, cutting unnecessary complexity and using technology to put traders first.      Our commitments to each other    We have each other’s backs   There when we need each other most   We challenge each other   Be more creative, more curious, more bold   We thrive together   Taking our work to the next level   We form strong bonds   Through team building and social events   We don’t judge   Instead, we teach and are open to learning   We step up   Taking ownership and supporting each other to do the same    Responsibilities   Own the brief-to-delivery pipeline: receive briefs from business stakeholders, resolve ambiguity proactively, and confirm deliverables, format and success criteria before a single pixel is placed.  Deliver high-quality UI to specification and on agreed timelines, communicating schedule risks immediately and transparently.  Work with fastidious attention to detail within our Figma design system, adhering to strict tokens & variables, design rules and naming conventions.  Create, maintain and extend reusable components using atomic design principles, keeping the system clean, consistent and scalable.  Partner closely with front-end developers to produce developer-ready handoffs — covering interaction states, edge cases and responsive behaviour — and participate in QA to ensure implementation matches design intent.  Proactively identify gaps and inconsistencies in the design system and propose well-considered resolutions.  Self-review and lead design crits for your work before submission, and iterate with pace and a positive attitude.    Requirements    Proven experience delivering production-ready UI reliably, to brief and on time.  Deep proficiency in Figma, including design systems, components, variants, auto-layout, prototyping and developer handoff.  Strong working knowledge of atomic design methodology.  Experience designing and launching app and web-based financial products.  Experience working with remote development teams and producing spec-quality handoffs.  A track record of embedding customer feedback, analytics (HotJar, Amplitude) and competitor insight into design thinking.  Experience validating and refining through A/B testing and prototyping.  A genuine love of designing simplicity — no matter how complex or regulated the product.     Preferred requirements    Experience designing trading platforms or other tightly regulated financial products.  Working knowledge of HTML/CSS sufficient to communicate accurately with developers.  Experience with Storybook or similar component documentation tools.  Exposure to AI-assisted design tooling, such as Figma Make or Claude.

e53fae0e2d514bcd.title: Director, Product Design
e53fae0e2d514bcd.jd: Director Product Design     Europe / Remote  Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer     About Velsera    Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.   We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.    The opportunity    You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.   That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.   This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.   The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.   This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.      What will you do?    Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.     Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.     Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.     Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.     Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.     Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.     Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.     Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.       Your first few months    The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.    Requirements    What do you bring to the table?   You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.    You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.     You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.     You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.     You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.     You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.     You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.     You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.     You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.     You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.    Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.       Why this position?   You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.    Benefits    Flexible Work & Time Off - Embrace hybrid work models and enjoy the freedom of unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance.  Health & Well-being - Access comprehensive group medical and life insurance coverage, along with a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and wellness support.  Growth & Learning - Fuel your professional journey with continuous learning and development programs designed to help you upskill and grow.  Engaging & Fun Work Culture - Experience a vibrant workplace with team events, celebrations, and engaging activities that make every workday enjoyable.  & Many More...

2ffb2ac216a8bd34.title: Post Production Manager
2ffb2ac216a8bd34.jd: Launch With Us - Post Production Manager    Function:  | Post Production | Workflow & Quality Management | Remote Team Leadership  Responsibility:  Leads the remote team of editors from planning and ingest to final delivery  Reports to:  Co-Founder  Location:  Remote First  Compensation:  £35,000 to £42,000     Overview:   At Launch With Us, we manage £25M+ in annual paid media across Meta, Google & TikTok for brands including Lucky Saint, Fem Fuelz, Butter & Crust, Four Five and Pets Pureset, taking them from £2-3M in revenue through £8M, £9M, £10M and beyond.  Creative and media sit on one team at Launch With Us, not two agencies bolted together and coordinated after the fact. Performance Media, Performance Creative, Paid Search and Growth Strategy all report into the same room, which is why we're ranked the UK's number one Independent Meta Agency Group by Meta, and part of the wider Soar Group.  As part of one of the UK’s leading independent agency groups, we operate with speed, autonomy, and a high level of ownership. There’s no red tape- just fast decision-making and the ability to move quickly. We’re also deeply AI-forward in how we think and operate, constantly evolving how we drive performance and efficiency for our brands.  Our team has quickly grown to 20+ operators after 120% YoY growth for the past 2 years. We offer remote-first working with access to our London office based in Camden, where all agencies in the group live! Culture, training, and professional development are at the heart of who we are, offering you structured training and clear progression into higher seats across the agency.  The Opportunity:  We’re looking for a proactive and detail-driven Post Production Manager to lead and optimise our post-production process across a growing team of remote editors. You’ll ensure every asset that leaves the studio meets our creative, performance, and delivery standards - balancing speed, consistency, and quality.  This is a pivotal role for the agency. You’ll keep the post-production team running efficiently day-to-day while also supporting the structure and culture that will scale as we grow. You’ll manage workflows, priorities, and people with clarity, helping the team stay aligned with creative KPIs, deadlines, and client outcomes.  You’ll also play a key role in identifying opportunities to enhance capabilities, from adopting AI-driven tools to supporting the recruitment and development of new post-production talent. And as a key part of a creative team built around e-commerce performance, you’ll bring a genuine passion for social-first content - understanding what makes a video stop the scroll, drive conversions, and resonate with online audiences.   Requirements   Your Impact:    Manage and assist in optimising the full post-production workflow from ingest to delivery across all brands and content formats.  Allocate projects and balance workloads across editors, ensuring smooth delivery and consistent creative output.  Oversee timelines, versioning, and delivery schedules, managing shifting priorities and delayed feedback calmly and efficiently.  Provide creative and performance-based feedback on edits, maintaining high storytelling and visual standards.  Collaborate with Producers, Strategists, and Account Managers to align expectations, communicate progress, and manage dependencies.  Keep the post-production team aligned with core creative and delivery KPIs, ensuring content meets both artistic and data-driven goals.  Identify and integrate AI tools to improve editing efficiency, asset management, and version control.  Support the growth of the post team, work closely with the senior editors, support in mentoring junior editors, helping define roles, and shaping scalable workflows as the agency expands.  Lead regular post-production meetings to review workload, quality, and upcoming priorities.  Maintain an organised post-production archive and clear delivery documentation.   Requirements   3-5+ years’ experience in post-production (agency, D2C, or social-first content environment preferred).  Experience managing remote creative teams and overseeing multiple concurrent projects.  Strong grasp of editing workflows and standards, social ad performance metrics, and storytelling for social platforms, eg - Meta and TikTok.  Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro and familiar with After Effects and emerging AI-assisted post tools (e.g. Veo, Runway, Adobe Sensei etc).  Exceptional organisational and project management skills able to juggle competing deadlines with calm and clarity.  Excellent communicator, confident managing expectations across creative, production, and strategy stakeholders.  Strong attention to detail, quality-focused mindset, and passion for improving creative processes.  Genuine interest in e-commerce and social-first creative - understanding what drives performance, audience engagement, and conversion through video.    Benefits    Join a fast-growing and ambitious company with a collaborative, people-first culture.  Benefit from a hybrid-first working model, with remote working and optional access to our London office for collaboration and team connection.  Enjoy 27 days of annual leave, plus Bank Holidays and your birthday off each year.  Work abroad for up to 30 days per year (T&Cs apply), giving you added flexibility and balance.  Benefit from a company pension scheme designed to support your long-term future.  Begin with a clear and structured employee progression roadmap designed to support your development from day one.  Access private health insurance after 6 months, helping you prioritise your wellbeing.  Receive life insurance cover alongside Smart Health wellbeing support services.  Benefit from a healthcare cash plan covering dental, optical, and physiotherapy support.  Follow a clear and structured progression plan designed to support your professional growth and career development.  Annual pay reviews, supported by quarterly performance evaluations and structured progression plans.  Enjoy monthly incentives and a Kudos reward scheme that recognises and celebrates great work.  Be rewarded through a Christmas performance bonus scheme.  Access ongoing training and personal development opportunities to continue building your skills and expertise.   As part of our hiring process, we may also introduce your profile to other relevant opportunities through our HAYRA platform — a curated network of leading e-commerce brands. This is designed to increase your chances of finding the right role, without needing to apply multiple times. If you would prefer to be considered for this role only, you can let us know at any stage.”

d9612106304fc357.jd: It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.  Join us to put AI to work for people.   AI is the most powerful technology IT departments have ever been asked to deploy. And ServiceNow is where powerful technology gets deployed, in the largest enterprises in the world. That’s where this position will sit, in the driver’s seat for the largest technology transformation Enterprises have ever seen.  Every enterprise is struggling to manage dozens of AI models, 100’s of app,1000’s of identities and services, and millions in token spend, to transform into AI-native organization.  They cannot do it with a dozen vendors each doing a piece. They need a platform. ServiceNow is that platform, and it is where our customers will deploy and manage AI from any vendor. We are looking for a leader to run our product marketing organization for this future. This is the moment where AI goes beyond parlor tricks and POCs and into the engine powering the of the world’s largest enterprises.  IT is where it starts and you will own that emergent category for AI-native and Autonomous IT across our market-leading portfolio, Autonomous Service Operations, IT Asset Management, and Portfolio and Enterprise Architecture, the vital backbone for the AI reinvention of companies worldwide.  Reporting to SVP, Product & Solutions Marketing, you will lead the category narrative, the AI-native innovation, and help our customers realize value from our Autonomous IT solutions. You will deliver cut through POVs and insights that fuel million-dollar campaigns. You will engage and activate a salesforce of 1000’s who will take our message to the market.  You're a product marketer at your core, sharp on positioning, messaging, launches and go-to-market strategy, but you operate at the altitude of a chief marketing officer. You think across business units, set the category agenda rather than react to it, and cut through a world that is way too noisy. You are credible in front of a CIO and a first-week intern in the same afternoon, and you move both to act. You inspire each.  You have AI curiosity and insight. You have already built new ways of working with AI in your own workflow and in your team's and you can show the work, not just talk about it.  You thrive on customer interaction, meeting with industry analysts, and the press. You galvanize talent around a common mission and build trusted bonds across the organization. You deeply understand technology and how it creates value for our customers. fb0b08af63acaaeb.jd: About InvestEngine  InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. About the Role  We are hiring a  Senior Product Designer  to join our  Growth stream  and help deliver consistently high-quality product design work at pace.  This is a hands-on IC contract role. The core expectation is simple:  deliver build-ready design with low churn . Especially on our highest-priority, higher-risk customer journeys, that means getting work to a confident, build-ready state with minimal rework, through strong upfront clarity, solid collaboration and good judgement.  You'll work closely with Product and Engineering day to day, and partner with Design on standards, craft and our evolving Design System  What You’ll Do    Own design work end-to-end in the Growth stream, from early framing through to build-ready delivery and iteration after release    Produce clear, implementation-ready design output such as flows, states, edge cases, content and acceptance criteria, so engineering has less back-and-forth    Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to clarify problems early and avoid late-stage rework    Contribute to Design System usage and consistency through your delivery, reusing and improving patterns where needed    Use AI as part of your workflow to accelerate exploration and delivery, in a way that stays repeatable and legible to the team    Take part in our research and evidence practice. We run concept, usability and comprehension testing across the team, and you'll help plan and run studies, then turn findings and product and behavioural data into design decisions    Design in a regulated context, with a strong bias toward clarity, fair treatment and customer comprehension    What We’re Looking For     5+ years of experience designing digital products as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.     Strong product design craft, spanning interaction design, systems thinking and end-to-end journey ownership    Comfortable being hands-on with research. You're happy to get stuck into user research as part of the role, with our support, and you make design decisions from evidence rather than opinion    Data-driven design. You use product and behavioural data, along with experiment results, to frame problems, prioritise and prove that designs actually work    High ownership and autonomy, comfortable operating as a senior contractor, clarifying ambiguity and driving work forward    Excellent collaboration, working as a partner to Product and Engineering rather than a service desk    Pragmatic judgement on quality versus speed, knowing where polish matters most    Comfort working within a design system and contributing to it    Comprehension-first, fair-treatment mindset. You design for genuine customer understanding, not just usability. Experience in a regulated environment such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, gambling or utilities is a strong advantage, but what matters most is that you can clearly evidence this mindset, whether or not it comes from regulated work    English fluency (C1 level and above) — we are a UK-based company, and the role involves regular communication with the team    Nice to Have    Experience with growth experimentation and funnel optimisation    Strong prototyping skills for quick validation    Prior experience operationalising AI in team workflows, beyond personal use    Fintech or investing-domain experience specifically. Regulated experience is a strong advantage, and the sector itself is a bonus    How We Work  We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and transparency. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root, not just treating the symptoms. Room to grow  As we scale, you’ll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities, influence how we work, and help shape our long-term direction.   Transparent and open culture  We share decisions openly, keep communication channels clear, and encourage collaboration across every part of the business.   Supportive, high-calibre team  Work alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.
