The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists 
 Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance 
 Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work 
 Hold the line on experience quality across the full app 
 
  User research  
 
 Plan and run your own user research: interviews, usability tests, diary studies, and in-app feedback loops 
 Turn qualitative and quantitative signals into actionable design decisions 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of who our users are, what motivates them, and where we lose them 
 Bring user evidence into every design conversation 
 
  Design execution  
 
 Build and evolve our next app version with fast protoptyping in Figma or Claude Design moving fast without sacrificing foundamentals 
 Design for the constraints of mobile: clarity, performance, and one-handed use 
 Maintain our design library and high-fidelity mock ups. Ensure consistency across components, patterns, and interaction models 
 Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship what you design 
 
  Iteration and quality  
 
 Define success metrics for your work and track them 
 Test your assumptions before and after launch 
 Spot what isn't working and fix it, with or without a brief 
 
 Requirements 
 
 6 to 7 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership 
 Proven ability to originate product concepts, not just refine existing ones 
 Deep mobile app design experience: you understand iOS patterns, constraints, and work with a small screen 
 Strong user research skills: you design the study, run it, synthesise it, and act on it 
 Expert-level Figma skills and a clean, efficient design process. Experience with AI tools to accelerate the whole design process. 
 Fast prototyping and concept validation: you build lightweight, testable prototypes early to prove or disprove an idea before committing to full design. You iterate quickly on evidence and know when something is ready to build and when it isn't 
 Able to design for behaviour change: you understand how habits form and how design can support or undermine them 
 Strong written English: your product design copy is natural and is an integral part of your designed flows 
 Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction 
 Based geographically in EU/UK timezone. Applications from Asia or the Americas will not be considered. 
 
  The following are strong advantages:  
 
 Experience in health, wellness, or longevity products 
 Experience building data products & data visualisations 
 B2C product experience 
 Fluency in German 
 
  Send a resume with a portfolio link or attachment showing work you have led: original concepts, user research, full journeys, shipped mobile experiences.

4b2aaf970f8706e7.jd: Product Designer    Middlesbrough or Lisbon - Hybrid       Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?    Who are we?  We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.  If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.  We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.      Purpose    To deliver high-quality, user-centric product design across Causeway’s suite of products, contributing to the CausewayOne Design Language and Design System while collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business teams to bring innovative solutions to life.  The Product Designer is a core member of the Product Design team, reporting directly to the Lead Designer. This role is responsible for end-to-end design of product features — from early-stage research and ideation through to detailed UI and handoff — ensuring all output meets the standards set by Concrete, the CausewayOne Design System.       Key Responsibilities        Product Design    •  Own end-to-end design of product features across web SaaS and mobile applications, from problem definition and research through to final UI design and developer handoff.   •  Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma, leveraging Concrete components, tokens, and patterns to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.   •  Conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesis to inform design decisions and advocate for user needs within product teams.   •  Contribute to design crits and async Figma reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to maintain a high bar for design quality.   •  Collaborate with product managers and engineers to ensure design intent is accurately implemented, supporting QA at key delivery stages.   •  Create rapid prototypes to support sales, strategic storytelling, and stakeholder communication.     Design System & Tooling    •  Apply and help maintain the Concrete Design System, including components, tokens, and usage guidelines, flagging gaps or improvements to the Lead Designer.   •  Maintain well-organised, properly named Figma files that align with team conventions and the development repository structure.   •  Contribute to scalable templates and shared libraries, supporting consistency and efficiency across the design team.     Collaboration & Growth    •  Work closely with the Lead Designer, Product Director, Product Owners, and engineering teams to align design work with product strategy and delivery priorities.   •  Actively participate in 1-2-1s and performance reviews, taking ownership of personal development goals and growth within the P3 level framework.   •  Support cross-product alignment by working collaboratively across teams to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.   •  Explore and adopt AI tools and techniques where they can improve design quality, innovation, and productivity.       Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications        Skills & Experience    •  A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work across web and/or mobile products, with clear evidence of user-centred design practice.   •  Proficiency in Figma, including components, auto-layout, and prototyping; experience working within or contributing to a design system is a strong advantage.   •  Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and accessibility best practices.   •  Experience working in an agile product environment, collaborating with product managers and developers throughout the delivery lifecycle.   •  Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale to stakeholders at varying levels.     Qualifications    •  A degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; typically 3–5 years of experience in product or UX design.   •  Experience in or appetite to learn about the Construction and/or Infrastructure sectors, and an interest in understanding how Causeway’s products serve that market.     What you get from us:   If you're looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. We believe everyone at Causeway has a vital role to play in our success. Causeway is fuelled by curiosity and is a place for people who beam with positivity and burn with ambition.  Our team is everything, so we’ll take good care of you. In fact, we give well-being the same priority as our other business goals. We’re strong advocates of work-life balance, offering hybrid working alongside the opportunity to work from modern, collaborative offices.     Our Values   We are      United . As part of a team, we’re better together.  We are    Agile . Be the change, we’re on a journey.  We are    Trusted . Do the right thing, we own this.  We are    Driven . Get stuck in, we make it happen.    Like all responsible companies Causeway is aware of the need to recognise the importance of protecting our environment and addressing the climate emergency. Causeway is a carbon neutral company and we offset our calculated carbon footprint. However, we recognise that offsetting is not a permanent solution, so we set environmental objectives to reduce our footprint year-on-year.

4c883a2a743561c7.jd:
About Co-Star 
 Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.  
 In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app.  Big Sean  has rapped about us, Ariana Grande &  Kevin Durant  post screenshots to their IGs, and we’ve been  App of the Day  twice. We’ve been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of  NYT Style . We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.  
 We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.  
 Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. 
 Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you’re experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It’s a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.  
 Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on.  An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.   
 We’re merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.  
 Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person’s unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called “wildly beautiful.” 
 We’re a small, experienced team.  
 Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).  
 About the brand designer role 
 We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what’s now but what’s next.  
 You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches — from concept through finished assets 
 Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery 
 Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate 
 Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like 
 Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team 
 
 You might be a fit if 
 
 You're a senior IC — roughly 5–8 years in — with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital 
 Typography and composition are your first language 
 You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them 
 You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet 
 You work well remotely and independently 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines) 
 Motion or illustration 
 You already make things with generative tools 
 
 Logistics 
 
 Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow 
 Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)  
 
 To apply 
 Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

Lead Product Designer 
  Team: Product, Research & Design  
   
  Prolific  
 Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 
  The Role  
 As the Product Design Lead in the Prolific for Participants Group, you will lead the design vision, strategy, and execution across three cross-functional teams. You’ll oversee participant experiences and authenticity within both our global marketplace and our dedicated specialist pool, as well as the internal services powering our participant models.  
 In addition to this leadership responsibility, you will be the hands-on designer responsible for the outcomes of a core participant domain, reporting to the VP of Product and collaborating with a world-class team of product engineers, AI researchers, and data scientists – as well as product managers and designers across Prolific. 
 You bring a background in crafting user-psychology-informed experiences for large-scale audiences and a natural ability to synthesize complex systems into elegant and transparent solutions. Thriving in ambiguity and juggling multiple initiatives, you move at a rapid pace while galvanizing exceptional performance around you. Ultimately, your success will be defined by your conceptual clarity, peer-to-peer bridge-building, and your consistent ability to bring the participant “into the room 
 Our Product, User Research, and Design Team indexes heavily on drive, commercial acumen, and pragmatism. Building on our Prolific Principles, we expect you to demonstrate reliability, grit, and bravery, and to model these traits within the team. You’ll be given a lot of trust and autonomy in return, as is always the case within Product at Prolific. 
  What you'll be doing  
 
 You'll bring your rich and varied design career experience to bear to solve customer problems and create new moments of joy for our participants who use Prolific—both ‘pocket money’ academic research participants around the world and deeply skilled experts working on AI training and evaluation. 
 You’ll build extensively for internal use cases and users, including in participant modeling platforms and tools for our Human Data Ops team. 
 You’ll raise the bar in our Design Team, and co-own cross-functional areas like accessibility (we are WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) and our Design System with other design leaders.  
 You will line-manage a group of 1-3 designers directly, and mentor others, coaching behaviours and skills, and modeling game-changing approaches by directly doing. 
 You'll have user research and data analysis responsibilities 
 
   
  What you'll bring  
 
 An extensive and varied track record of in-house product design work alongside product managers and engineers. (Pure agency experience is likely to be screened out.) 
 Experience in either line-managing or acting as player/coach for other designers. 
 Confidence working with AI prototyping tools. We use Figma Make. 
 Competence or expertise in the industry's standard design tools, principles, and methodologies, and a basic to detailed understanding of how AI models work. 
 
  Even better if you have  
 
 A lived experience of a rapidly scaling startup – especially if you loved it! 
 AI training experience, or a data science or computer science background. 
 A track record of giving back to your Product/Design community. 
 A track record of excelling across all your pursuits, beyond your chosen career. 
 
  Why Prolific is a great place to work  
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. 
 Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

 Remote-friendly work culture with support for professional development and engagement with the design community.

Who we are  
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
 Who we are 
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
  About This Role  
 We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (Design System) who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces. In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code. 
  Responsibilities  
 
 UI Craft & Visual Excellence: Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements. 
 Component Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products. 
 Interaction & Motion Design: Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive. 
 Design Token Management: Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code. 
 Figma Library Architecture: Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately. 
 Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments. 
 Documentation & Governance: Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used. 
 
  Experience & Background  
 
 Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features. 
 Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android. 
 Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows. 
 Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories. 
 
  Skills & Competencies  
 
 Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication. 
 Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles. 
 Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology. 
 Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines. 
 
  What Success Looks Like in This Role  
 
 High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles. 
 Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS). 
 Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance. 
 Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction. 
 
  Why Join Us  
 
 Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. 
 Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. 
 
  How to apply:  
 Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

 As the Head of Design, you will lead our design organisation, owning the design quality of every customer journey end-to-end — how our client-facing touchpoints across product, web and more look, feel, and function at every step — in close partnership with Product, who own the journeys and priorities, and Marketing, who lead brand strategy and identity. 
 This is a broad executive mandate where you will own not only the craft of design but its measurable impact on the business. You will champion design excellence, build deep partnerships with Product and Marketing to ensure a single, cohesive experience from first impression to daily use, and grow a world-class remote design culture. Your mission is to translate complex financial and cryptocurrency concepts into a beautiful, cohesive, and trust-building experience — and to demonstrate, through outcomes, that great design is working. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 
  Design Strategy and Vision.  Define, champion, and execute the long-term design vision for Xapo's client-facing touchpoints across mobile and web — treating measurable user-experience quality, not just aesthetics, as the standard of success.   
  Design Performance & Outcomes.  Own the metrics that demonstrate design's business impact such as task-completion and speed in core journeys and design-system adoption, reporting on these quarterly at the executive level.   
  Operational Leadership of the Design Function.  Run design as a fully accountable business function, owning headcount planning, prioritisation, and delivery, so the organization scales predictably alongside Product and Engineering.

Partner closely with Marketing, who lead Xapo's brand strategy and identity, to ensure that brand is expressed faithfully throughout the user journey — creating a seamless aesthetic and narrative transition from public campaigns to in-app transactional flows, with clear swimlanes and shared rituals between the two teams.   
  UX Architecture and Flow Optimisation.  Oversee user research and journey mapping to elevate the design and usability of complex regulatory, private banking, and crypto-native payment flows — working with Product, who own the journeys themselves, to reduce friction without compromising security.   
  Design Systems and Operations.  Scale and govern a unified design language and Figma system — co-developed with Marketing's brand team where the system touches brand expression — to drive velocity, consistency, and visual quality across product and web.   
  Operationalised Research and Testing.  Standardise a culture of data-informed design, embedding regular usability testing and customer discovery as a standard gate before handoff to ensure high-quality, validated releases.   
  Cross-Functional Executive Collaboration.  Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership so the design organisation is engaged early, bringing craft and usability expertise into strategic direction and product requirements from the earliest stages — and act as design's ambassador to Marketing, Compliance, and other key stakeholders.   
  Responsible AI Design Governance.  Partner with security and AI engineering teams to establish a safe, governed framework for utilising AI tools in asset creation and UX personalisation.   
  Team Leadership and Culture.  Recruit, mentor, and lead a remote, multi-disciplinary design organisation spanning Product Design, Research, and UX Writing, fostering a culture of craft, critique, and continuous growth. 
 
   
 Skills needed 
 
 10+ years of digital design experience, with at least 4+ years in an executive leadership role (Director/VP) managing multi-disciplinary design teams in a high-growth fintech, neobank, or digital asset platform.   
 Broad creative fluency, with a strong portfolio demonstrating complex interactive product design executed to a high aesthetic standard, and a proven ability to work within and extend an established brand identity.   
 Proven track record of improving key business and design metrics (conversion, NPS, task completion, and platform ratings) through design-led initiatives.   
 Demonstrated ability to resolve operational friction, streamline design workflows, and build high-trust partnerships with marketing, product, and engineering teams — particularly experience navigating shared ownership of brand between design and marketing functions.   
 Deep knowledge of native mobile platform guidelines (iOS and Android) and modern Web standards, along with experience scaling enterprise-grade design systems.   
 Strong familiarity with the unique UX and trust challenges in fintech, banking, and digital assets.   
 Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate the business value of design decisions to the C-suite and board.   
 Operational, direct, and collaborative leadership style tailored for a fully remote, globally distributed environment. 
 
   
  Other requirements  
   
 
 A dedicated workspace. 
 A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. 
 Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. 
   Why work for Xapo? 
 Impact Globally, Work Remotely. 
 
 
  Shape the Future   Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  Expect Excellence   Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn   how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.    
 
 
 At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

 The Associate Director, Visual Design, is a cornerstone of our creative leadership, tasked with defining the aesthetic North Star for our organization. This is not just a role for a master craftsperson, but for a strategic visionary who can translate business objectives into world-class visual ecosystems. You won't just meet benchmarks; you will redefine them. 
   
 You will sit at the intersection of brand, product, and strategy, ensuring that our visual identity is cohesive, future-proof, and disruptive.   WHAT YOU’LL DO:  
 
 Closely collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of talented people. 
 Set the overarching visual strategy and design principles that guide the entire creative department across all touchpoints (digital, brand, and product).

  Act as a primary creative partner to C-suite executives and key client stakeholders, using design as a lever to solve complex business challenges. 
 Partner with cross-functional leaders to ensure technical feasibility and strategic alignment from ideation to launch. 
 Serve as an evangelist for design excellence both internally and externally, staying ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies (AI, spatial design, etc.) to keep the agency/company at the cutting edge. 
 Refine design workflows and philosophies to improve the quality of output while maintaining organizational agility and profitability. 
 Bring a fresh, insightful point of view that inspires both the internal team and the client, putting the team and client first. 
 Generate strategic insights and moodboards to facilitate creative innovation. 
 Drive complex digital projects from kick-off to completion, ensuring the team's deliverables exceed client expectations and stay within budget and deadlines.  
 Establish project direction, craft guidelines, and assist with production as needed. 
 Identify key client decision-makers and leverage excellent interpersonal skills to grow and maintain these relationships, collaborating across all internal departments and external stakeholders to achieve desired results. 
 Actively contribute to the design discipline through mentoring, conversation, and proposing ideas to elevate company operations and improve processes. 
 
   
  WHAT YOU BRING:  
 
 5+ years of experience in visual and interactive design for global brands, with at least 4 years in a dedicated leadership position. 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 Mastery of Figma (including components, variants, and auto layout) and familiarity with essential collaboration tools (e.g., Hubspot, Google Suite, Slack). 
 Strong knowledge and experience in visual design, user-centered experience design, interaction design, and brand development. Experience developing and maintaining a robust design system. 
 AI-Enhanced Production Ecosystems: Advanced capability in adopting and implementing generative AI tools (such as Midjourney, Runway, Vizcom, and Weavy) into the design pipeline to maximize asset velocity, explore vanguard concepts, and drive structural innovation. 
 Design Systems for Paid Media Scale: Demonstrated expertise in bridging robust design systems with performance marketing initiatives. Responsible for architecting and optimizing scalable, modular components in Figma specifically designed for dynamic paid ads and multi-channel marketing matrices (Meta, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest). 
 Demonstrated ability to provide strategic vision and creative inspiration to large, diverse teams. 
 Excellent public speaking and presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to clients and internal stakeholders. 
 Highly detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable navigating complex organizations, and focused on strategic problem-solving and process efficiency.

 Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

Job Overview  
  Wargaming Kyiv  is looking for a  Game Designer  to join the World of Tanks team and take ownership of complex game features, with a primary focus on late game such as  Clans and Ranked/Competitive  modes. 
  Reports to  
 Lead Game Designer 
  What will you do?  
 
 Own features end-to-end: from problem definition and design through implementation, release, analysis, and further iteration. 
 Design and develop metagame and core gameplay systems. 
 Collaborate closely with development, analytics, UX, UI, art, level design, and other game design teams. 
 Use player behavior, statistics, research, and live-game data to validate assumptions and drive design decisions. 
 
  What are we looking for?  
 
 2+ years of professional Game Design experience. 
 Proven experience with feature ownership. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for a large feature rather than only contributing to individual parts of it. 
 Strong generalist Game Design skills, with particular experience designing and documenting large, interconnected systems. 
 Strong understanding of metagame systems, progression, competitive modes, social/clan systems, or other long-term player engagement mechanics.

 We are looking for a visionary and hands-on leader to join us as Head of  Digital Product  for China, a strategic,  consumer-centric  leadership position with end-to-end accountability for shaping the full digital product and consumer experience for millions of customers in China. This covers the entire  omni-channel  journey — from online/offline integration to key local platforms like  WeChat Miniprogram  and  China Digital Marketplaces . 
   
 You will serve as the center of  consumer, digital experience, technology, and project management , defining the product vision and roadmap, and co-owning execution with Engineering and Commercial leadership to build data-driven, personalized experiences that attract, convert, and retain customers. 
  Your Mission:  
 Your mission is to shape and articulate a compelling product vision and long-term strategy for On’s  omni-channel digital consumer experiences  in China. 
   
 You will serve as the  center of consumer, digital experience, technology, and project management , owning how our products attract, engage, and retain customers across all commercial channels — Retail, Wholesale, Local DTC (WeChat), and China Marketplaces — ensuring experiences are premium, locally relevant, and globally scalable. 
   
 As the strategic owner of the China customer product portfolio, you will define how data, personalization, and seamless cross-channel journeys come together to drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and commercial growth. You will guide the evolution and integration of both global platforms and locally built capabilities, ensuring a seamless, end-to-end customer journey across offline and online touchpoints, with a core focus on  WeChat Miniprogram  and  China Digital Marketplaces . 
   
 A core part of your mission is to elevate  Digital Product  in China to a true strategic partnership — deeply understanding customer and business needs, shaping direction early, and co-owning outcomes with Technology and Commercial leadership. 
   
 You will serve as a key connector between China and the global organization, turning local insights into global advantage and helping build a world-class, interconnected digital experience that fuels On’s growth in China and beyond. 
   
  Key Responsibilities  
  Define Product Vision & Strategy:   Shape and articulate a compelling product vision and long-term strategy for customer experiences in China, aligned with On’s global brand, commercial goals, and technology strategy.  
 
 
 Translate complex market dynamics, customer insights, and business priorities into clear product principles and actionable roadmaps. 
 
 
  Lead Omni-Channel Customer Experiences  
 
 
 Own the end-to-end product experience across Retail, Wholesale, Local DTC (WeChat), and China Marketplaces. 
 Ensure a connected, cohesive, premium, and locally relevant experience across all touchpoints while enabling global scalability. 
 
 
  Drive Roadmap Ownership & Execution  
 
 
 Lead the development, prioritization, and execution of product roadmaps, balancing speed, quality, and long-term value together with your tech counterpart.  
 Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Commercial leaders to ensure high-quality, predictable delivery of strategic initiatives. 
 
 
  Champion Customer & Market Insights  
 
 
 Promote a deep understanding of Chinese customer behaviors, expectations, and journeys, ensuring insights are consistently reflected in product decisions. 
 Embed customer discovery, research, and validation into how teams work. 
 
 
  Inspire & Develop High-Performing Teams  
 
 
 Build, mentor, and empower a high-performing product organization in China. 
 Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and outcome-driven thinking, enabling teams to do their best work. 
 
 
  Foster Innovation & Continuous Improvement  
 
 
 Encourage experimentation and learning to evolve customer experiences, personalization, and engagement models. 
 Partner with Tech and Data leaders to leverage modern technologies and AI-driven capabilities where they create meaningful customer and business impact. 
 
 
  Leverage Data for Growth & Impact  
 
 
 Establish a data-driven decision-making culture, defining success metrics tied to customer engagement, retention, and commercial performance. 
 Use insights and experimentation to guide prioritization, justify investments, and continuously improve outcomes. 
 
 
  Act as the China Product Voice Globally  
 
 
 Represent China’s product needs and opportunities within the global organization. 
 Share learnings and innovations from China to help influence global product strategy and platform evolution. 
 
 
  Your Story:  
  Proven Product Leadership: You bring 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including senior leadership roles where you’ve led teams delivering complex, customer-facing products at scale. You have a strong track record of owning outcomes across strategy, execution, and impact.  Strategic & Customer-Centric Mindset: You possess a sharp strategic mindset and the ability to translate complex business and customer challenges into clear, actionable product visions and roadmaps. You naturally connect customer needs, business objectives, and product strategy, and you know how to make trade-offs that drive long-term value.  
 
  Deep Understanding of the China Digital Ecosystem:  You have strong experience operating in the China digital landscape, with a solid understanding of local customer behaviors, platforms, and expectations. You are comfortable working across DTC ecosystems (e.g. WeChat), retail, wholesale, and marketplaces, and know how to tailor experiences for local relevance while contributing to global scale. 
 
  Strong Product & Technical Acumen: You have a solid grasp of modern digital product technologies and data-driven product development. You collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data leaders, confidently engaging in discussions around architecture, feasibility, scalability, and quality, ensuring product ambition is matched by strong execution.  Inspirational People Leader: You are a people-first leader with a passion for building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product teams. You set a high bar, create clarity, and foster an environment of trust, ownership, and continuous learning.  Exceptional Communicator & Influencer: You are a clear, compelling communicator who can articulate product strategy and complex ideas to diverse audiences — from engineering teams to senior executives. You are skilled at navigating complex stakeholder environments, building alignment, and influencing decisions across regions and functions.  Global Mindset, Local Impact: You have experience working in global organizations, partnering across cultures and time zones. You are comfortable representing local needs on a global stage — and translating global strategy into meaningful, impactful execution in China.  
 
  Fluent in English and Mandarin:  You are able to operate confidently in cross-cultural environments. 
 
  Your Team:  
 You will be part of the Digital and Consumer, China organization, with extended collaboration and partnership with the global and China Commercial, Digital and Tech organizations.  Working in close partnership with Commercial, Engineering, Data, and business leaders across China and APAC, you will shape and execute a cohesive product vision that enables scale, transparency, and organizational agility. 
   
  On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

In Short   
 As Head of Production Planning, your core responsibility would be to ensure. On’s manufacturing partner base is aligned with the brand’s goals of expansion, product availability, sustainability & commitment to premium quality Apparel & Accessories.  As a key member of the Global Apparel & Accessories organization, you will be based in Hanoi, Vietnam, with frequent travel within Asia, Europe, and Zurich. 
 This is your opportunity to become part of the world's fastest-growing sports company. On is not only targeting to disrupt the product and supply chain landscape of shoes but also of apparel and accessories.

  Long-range capacity planning  
 
 Build a 3-5 years production capacity strategy for On, based on the long-range plan for T1 (product manufacturing) & T2 (material manufacturing) partners with inputs and alignment with  functional stakeholders like Product Strategy, Demand Planning, Supply Planning and Sourcing team, including Head of Operations, Commercialization, Materials & Quality 
 The strategy should ensure substantial capacity is planned in line with the brand's volume growth targets for key product categories by identifying the gaps and ensuring regional diversification to mitigate sourcing risks.

 Lead internal audits for sourcing and act as a go-to person for all matters related to supplier contracts and negotiations.

 Facilitate the seasonal allocation process between demand & Supply planning, Product Creation & internal Sourcing team and share final allocation with Suppliers post each calendar milestone. 
 Mitigate seasonal capacity issues in alignment with Demand & Supply planning. Manage Buy readiness for purchase order placement prior to each order placement by Supply Planning 
 Work on Material booking strategy with Supply planning & T2 to shorten Lead time & optimize forecasted material utilization. 
 Establish & maintain good working relationships with all Manufacturing partners by regular factory visits & by taking timely decisions to make business with On efficient. 
 Lead efficiency projects for Manufacturing like level loading, continuous production & optimal capacity utilization and coordinate with the Head of Operations for Implementation at supplier level 
 Manage implementation of planning & warehousing SOP projects with suppliers- RFID, Direct shipments, Scan & Pack, etc.—across suppliers 
 
  Your Story  
 
 Accessories categories. Hands-on experience of 4-5 years in a manufacturing establishment will be a plus 
 Basic knowledge of technical products & GSD proficiency 
 A degree or qualification in garment manufacturing is preferable 
 Strong analytical & problem-solving skills 
 Proven track record of leading highly motivated teams. Strong communication &  interpersonal skills and ability to work with multicultural teams 
 Proficiency in English is a must to cooperate among the teams (Zurich and global teams) 
 An entrepreneurial and open mindset, an eagerness for differentiation and a natural push for excellence. 
 
  Meet Your Team  
 Your team shall consist of direct reporting of Lead Capacity planning, Lead Material Planning, Operational Planners & Logistic Specialists with matrix reporting of Production planners in the different regions

7e67726725f30559.title: Research Leader / Senior Scientist (Computational Drug Design), Cambridge, MA
7e67726725f30559.jd:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease. 
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery.  
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture. 
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.  
   
  About Iso  
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed. 
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases. 
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design. 
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI. 
      About the Applied Computational Drug Design team  
 We are a dynamic team of Computational Chemists transforming how drug discovery happens. By partnering deeply with our machine learning colleagues, we are doing more than just leveraging the Isomorphic Labs drug design engine - we are actively shaping it. We use our computational expertise to challenge and refine our algorithms, creating a powerful symbiotic relationship between data and computation that drives our internal and collaborative portfolios. Our team works closely together in a supportive environment, where everyone is valued for their computational chemistry expertise and the experience they bring to the group. We have a strong growth mindset and prioritise continued development and learning. 
   
  Your impact  
 We’re hiring at the Research Leader and Senior Scientist levels, and you can apply for either position using the application form below. These roles are ideal for experienced computational chemists who are eager to shape the future of drug discovery at the intersection of computational chemistry and artificial intelligence. 
 Working as either a Program Lead or a Computational Chemistry Lead, you will provide scientific expertise and strategic direction for portfolio drug discovery projects, guiding them from initiation towards clinical candidate selection. Working alongside world-leading ML scientists, you will play a critical role in enhancing our AI platform through your technical expertise, and apply these improvements to drug design projects. You will have experience of working broadly across drug discovery projects, with the ability to think originally and critically, knowing when to apply innovative ideas, and think with a fresh approach. If you are a skilled Computational Chemist with a passion for applying cutting-edge technology to complex scientific challenges, this role offers an unparalleled opportunity for impact and growth. 
 As part of this hiring, some roles will have people management responsibilities for building teams of 2-3 Computational Chemists. In this case, you will be responsible for line managing and mentoring a talented and high-performing team, encouraging their scientific growth and career development. You’ll champion our cross-disciplinary approach, fostering a supportive team culture where continuous learning and the adoption of next-generation tools are the standard, not the exception. 
   
  What you will do  
 
 Apply AI-first approaches to provide technical and strategic directions, and execute drug design programs. Take ownership as either an overall Program Lead or Computational Chemistry Lead. 
 Collaborate cross-functionally to support the data-driven delivery of high quality scientific solutions to complex technical problems 
 Establish principles for embedding cutting-edge AI/ML into modern computational chemistry workflows, ensuring seamless integration across ML, Biology, and Chemistry teams. 
 Provide strategic input and technical direction to our ML platform teams. 
 If Program Leadership: Champion the drug discovery pipeline, overseeing external collaborations (with CROs) and leading programs to meet critical go/no-go milestones. Prepare detailed scientific proposals and reports to support new and ongoing programs.  
 Embrace and champion our culture of inclusion and continuous professional development. 
 
   
  Skills and qualifications   
  Essential:  
 
 PhD in Computational Chemistry, or a related scientific field, or equivalent industrial experience. 
 8+ / 5+ years of professional experience in a Computational Drug Design role, operating within a biotech, pharma or CRO setting. 
 Proven track record of project leadership / leading computational chemistry efforts on drug discovery programs, demonstrating significant contributions to project progression (ideally from hit identification through to lead optimisation or candidate nomination). 
 Expertise in writing and implementing Python scripts for analysis and tool development, and/or utilising pipelining tools to support cheminformatics and design workflows. 
 A genuine passion for drug discovery and enthusiasm for the potential of ML to transform the field. 
 For a people / program management position: experience of leading a high-performing scientific team, mentoring and empowering them to thrive in their roles. 
 Strong track record of scientific achievements, evidenced by publications, patents, and presentations. 
 Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with an ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, collaborative team environment. 
 Track record of strategic thinking and creative problem solving with a strong growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to learn new concepts and techniques. 
 
  Nice to have:  
 
 Prior experience leveraging machine learning and generative AI methods for hit finding (e.g. ultra-large virtual screening and active learning), molecular design and lead optimisation (e.g. REINVENT, cofolding and AI-powered ligand/pose scoring methods). 
 Knowledge of other specific drug discovery approaches like fragment-based drug design (FBDD), and alternative modalities like PROTACs, molecular glues, PPI inhibitors or stabilisers, peptides etc. 
 Understanding of drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (ADME + DMPK) principles. 
 Fluency in Python with ability to write code for new tools. 
 Track record of authorship of relevant scientific manuscripts and/or inventorship of composition of matter patents. 
 Experience working with or managing activities at contract research organisations (CROs). 
     Culture and values  
 We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it.  
  Thoughtful   Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.  
  Brave   Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.  
  Determined   Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.  
  Together   Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.  
   Creating an extraordinary company  
 We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact. 
 We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know. 
   Hybrid working  
 It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and  would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week  (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call. 
  Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our  privacy policy .

About Us  
 Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. 
 We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on  LinkedIn  and  X ,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our  Blog . Be sure to explore our  Interviewing Guide  to learn how to ace our interview process. 
  About the Team  
 The Twitch UX Monetization team is responsible for helping streamers monetize on Twitch through viewer engagement across our product experiences. A Senior UX Designer on the Monetization Team is expected to lead design work at the program level, work with senior XFN partners, represent work to executive leadership, guide and mentor junior designers and will report directly to the Monetization Director of Design. 
  About the Role  
 Designers at Twitch are involved in development from project conception all the way through execution and iteration. You will have the opportunity to do hands-on research and collaborate closely with engineers. If you are a champion for designing for humans and create playful and caring software for your customers, you will flourish on this team. 
  You Will:  
 
 Collaborate with a cross functional development team of product managers, engineers, and designers 
 Learn from streamers and viewers about the ways they use our services and their desires to accomplish more 
 Think creatively about how to solve problems that will sustain streamers’ communities 
 Give back to the design community at Twitch by using and improving existing patterns and approaches 
 Combine qualitative and quantitative information to develop hypotheses about customer motivations and use that to improve your designs 
 Present your work to others by participating in design reviews and feedback sessions 
 Mentor and grow junior designers and help instill best practices with our team 
 
  You Have:  
 
 5+ years of practical experience in UX design with an emphasis on content discovery and/or content engagement experiences. 
 Demonstrated interaction design and visual craft skills including experience with prototyping mobile experiences 
 Have experience incorporating AI tooling as part of your design workflows. 
 Have experience streaming, working with broadcasting softwares and/or creating UGC content.  
 Demonstrated skills collaborating closely with other designers, researchers, product managers and engineers 
 Demonstrated ability to impact product strategy and roadmaps 
 An aesthetic sense and the ability to make confident decisions 
 Demonstrated empathy for the people using your software or products 
 Expertise with Figma

 Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance 
 401(k)

 Flexible PTO 
 Amazon Employee Discount

 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. 82b067cf1f25bead.jd:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.    About the Product team   
 The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision. 
 About the role 
 The Chief of Staff to the SVP of Product is the strategic thought partner and proxy to the leader. The role exists to scale the product leadership function: by anchoring on the leveraged people problems most central to the org, by owning the external product narrative end-to-end, and by being on point for strategic bets that need a single accountable owner (ex: AI enablement, special projects). 
   
 The end goal is a healthy Product org with pillar leads running independently at high quality, decisions made with less latency, and a clearer story about where Product is going, and why. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 
 Design and run the product leadership team’s rhythms (staff meetings, product reviews, all-teams, offsites): agenda architecture, pre-reads, decision capture, follow-through 
 
 
 Co-own the people rhythms with the HRBP across hiring, calibrations, performance, and talent reviews. Surface emergent structural risks (broken hiring funnels, attrition signals, single points of failure) with proactive solutions 
 
 
 Partners with Technology Operations function to define and improve processes for roadmap planning, driving prioritization decisions, setting annual OKRs and tracking progress to goals throughout the year  
 
 
 Own headcount planning and budget management alongside the Finance and HR Business Partners: annual planning, quarterly reforecasts, hire-prioritization tradeoffs 
 
 
 Drive AI retooling and enablement, including running internal AI masterclasses for leadership and natively embedding AI-enabled processes across the function 
 
 
 Curate the external product narrative (all-hands, written updates, major external talks): operate as a speechwriter, partnering with PR, comms, and brand 
 
 
 Prepare executive briefings and leadership communications, and reduce decision latency across the Product leadership team 
 
 
 Run a recurring org health pulse (engagement scores, regrettable attrition, leveling drift, manager effectiveness), escalating early signals before they become structural problems 
 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 
 10+ years in roles that built product credibility and strategic-narrative chops: strategy with deep product partnership, or a prior CoS role to a senior product or engineering executive at a high-growth tech company 
 
 
 A track record of running people processes at scale (hiring, calibrations, leveling, talent reviews) in a fast-growing organization 
 
 
 Exceptional written communication: you can ghostwrite, synthesize narrative from raw inputs, and draft a board page that holds up under scrutiny 
 
 
 Pattern-matching for organizational dysfunction: the muscle to spot a broken hiring funnel, a single point of failure, or a leadership gap before anyone names it 
 
 
 Comfort operating with influence and without authority across senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Design, Revenue, Finance, and HR 
 
 
 Strong analytical foundation and business acumen: fluent enough in product metrics, financials, and growth analytics to reason about tradeoffs without delegating every quantitative question 
 
 
 Why this role matters 
 Affirm’s next phase of growth depends on Product moving from a function powered by heroics to a function powered by a world-class operating system. The Chief of Staff is the linchpin of the strategic side of that change: the partner who helps make the strategy clear, the org stronger, and the leader’s leverage real.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.   The Repayment UX team owns one of the most high-trust surfaces across Affirm’s products: the moment a customer pays us back. We’re a full-stack team based entirely in Europe within the same time zone, but culturally rooted in Silicon Valley. The user journeys we build and own reach more than 20 million people who together repay over $40B in loans each year. We are full-stack owners of the Manage tab within our mobile and web apps, where customers stay on top of their payment plans and make the payments. 
 We are looking for an empowering, accountable Engineering Manager to lead and grow Repayment UX. You’ll set the team’s technical direction, taking ownership of their roadmap, delivery and on-call support. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and other Engineering teams. You’ll take a high-performing team anchored to their tech lead and give it dedicated leadership. 
 If you are passionate about creating world-class user experiences and excited by the challenge of directly owning a critical part of a fast-growing product – join us. Help build the next generation of Affirm’s apps, improving people’s lives at scale. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 
 You will lead and grow a well-balanced team of engineers – setting clear expectations, giving direct feedback, and developing each engineer toward their next level. 
 
 
 You will own the team’s technical strategy and multi-quarter roadmap, tying it to initiatives that build customer trust and move Affirm’s business. 
 
 
 You will empower your tech lead and engineers to hold the design and quality bar, supporting them hands-on throughout technical design and cross-functional alignment. 
 
 
 You will own the availability, reliability, and performance of consumer-critical systems – on-call, incident response, and reducing operational toil. 
 
 
 You will keep the team shipping in small increments, breaking large programs into sprint-sized milestones with clear, accountable owners. 
 
 
 You will partner across Product, Design, and Analytics, and other Engineering teams, building trust and taking part in cross-functional efforts. 
 
 
 You will guide the team to multiply their output through focus and leverage, including agentic AI. 
 
 
 You will drive hiring and onboarding to grow a diverse, high-performing team, and foster a culture of ownership, quality, and transparency. 
 
 On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement. 
 
  What we look for  
 
 
 You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing and growing engineering teams. 
 
 
 You have proven experience delivering consumer-facing software and driving execution through ambiguity. 
 
 
 You have a track record of managing performance directly – setting clear expectations, giving candid feedback, and developing engineers toward results and growth. 
 
 
 You have the technical judgment required to guide architecture, quality, and reliability decisions, with the instinct to empower senior engineers to make the calls rather than making them all yourself.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.    About the InfoSec & IT Team   
 The Application Security team helps Affirm build and launch products that earn customer trust, meet compliance obligations, and reduce business risk. We partner closely with product, engineering, infrastructure, risk, compliance, and other teams to identify security risks early, recommend pragmatic mitigations, and help teams find safe paths to launch. 
 We are looking for an early-career Application Security Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and comfortable working with code. You will help assess application risks, support vulnerability management efforts, partner with engineering teams on secure design decisions, and contribute lightweight tooling, automation, and code-informed analysis that helps AppSec scale across Affirm. 
 This role is a great fit for someone who has hands-on software or security experience, enjoys reading and reasoning about code, is actively developing offensive security skills, and wants to apply those skills in a product-minded, risk-based way. 
  What You'll Do  
 
 
 Partner with product and engineering teams to identify application security risks and help frame them as clear business risks, launch options, and recommended next steps. 
 
 
 Read application code, configuration, pull requests, logs, and documentation to understand how systems work and where security risks may exist. 
 
 
 Contribute small code changes, scripts, detections, tests, secure defaults, or automation that improve AppSec workflows and reduce recurring issues. 
 
 
 Work in GitHub to review code changes, understand engineering context, participate in pull request discussions, track remediation work, and collaborate with engineers. 
 
 
 Help evaluate vulnerabilities from internal testing, bug bounty reports, security tooling, penetration tests, and other sources; partner with teams to prioritize and remediate issues based on real-world risk. 
 
 
 Contribute to vulnerability management workflows, including triage, validation, severity assessment, remediation guidance, tracking, and reporting. 
 
 
 Translate recurring security findings into repeatable mechanisms such as secure coding guidance, checklists, paved paths, lightweight automation, detection logic, reusable review patterns, or developer-facing documentation. 
 
 
 Work with engineers to understand system designs, data flows, trust boundaries, authentication and authorization models, code paths, and potential abuse cases. 
 
 
 Communicate security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including the risk, tradeoffs, recommended mitigations, and residual risk. 
 
 
 Build strong relationships across Affirm teams and influence security outcomes without relying on formal authority. 
 
 
 Help connect AppSec work to customer trust, regulatory/compliance expectations, operational resilience, and business outcomes. 
 
 
 Continue developing hands-on offensive, defensive, and software engineering skills through practical work, labs, tooling, research, certifications, or contributions to internal security programs. 
 
 
  What We Look For  
 
 
 0–2+ years of experience in application security, software engineering, security engineering, vulnerability management, penetration testing, security operations, or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 
 Foundational programming ability in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin, or similar. 
 
 
 Comfort reading, navigating, and reasoning about code, even in unfamiliar codebases. 
 
 
 Experience using Git and GitHub or similar version-control workflows, including branches, commits, pull requests, code review, issues, or project tracking. 
 
 
 Some hands-on experience building, testing, breaking, or securing software. This could include professional experience, internships, security labs, CTFs, bug bounty work, open-source contributions, personal projects, automation scripts, internal tools, or coursework. 
 
 
 Ability to write clear, maintainable scripts or small programs to solve practical problems, automate manual workflows, analyze data, validate findings, or improve security processes. 
 
 
 Foundational understanding of common web, API, mobile, cloud, and application security risks, such as OWASP Top 10 issues, authentication and authorization flaws, injection, insecure design, secrets exposure, dependency risks, and data protection concerns. 
 
 
 Interest in offensive security, such as studying for or completing security certifications, practicing web/API testing, learning exploit development fundamentals, using tools like Burp Suite, or participating in labs and capture-the-flag environments. 
 
 
 Exposure to vulnerability management concepts, including triage, severity assessment, remediation tracking, false-positive analysis, compensating controls, and risk-based prioritization. 
 
 
 Ability to reason about risk and tradeoffs, not just identify issues. You can explain what could go wrong, how likely it is, what impact it may have, and what options exist to reduce risk. 
 
 
 Strong product and engineering empathy. You seek to understand launch goals, technical constraints, user impact, and business priorities before recommending a path forward. 
 
 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain security findings in practical, actionable terms. 
 
 
 A collaborative mindset and comfort working across product, engineering, compliance, risk, infrastructure, and security teams. 
 
 
 Curiosity, humility, and a growth mindset. You proactively seek feedback, ask good questions, and continue building your technical depth. 
 
 
 Secure-by-design judgment, including the ability to spot patterns, recommend simple controls, and balance launch velocity with meaningful risk reduction.

 You act like an owner with a bias for action and integrity.

 Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

 Deep expertise in programming (e.g., Python, Go, or C/C++) 
 Strong background in networking protocols, Linux/RHEL systems, and distributed architecture 
 Experience in high-stakes incident management and participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation 
 Proficiency in leveraging ITIL frameworks and incident data to drive service maturity through systematic problem management and technical operability reviews

 Experience with chaos engineering and disaster recovery planning at scale 
 Expertise in global routing (BGP) and traffic tunneling (GRE, IPSec) with a deep understanding of L7 proxy architectures (HAProxy), DNS at scale, and OS networking stack internals

65aa9a9fe4b49e87.title: Sr. Product Designer, Ordering
65aa9a9fe4b49e87.jd:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers. 
 By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise. 
 Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone. 
 If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.    About the Role  
 As the Sr. Product Designer for the Ordering team, you'll own the end-to-end experience for a web application used by corporate users who own the grocery replenishment function across tens of thousands of departments nationwide. You'll turn complex AI-driven forecasts into decisions these operators can act on with confidence. You'll work closely with product management, machine learning engineers, and mobile and full-stack engineers to create a holistic end-to-end experience. Your ownership, attention to detail, and your focus on outcomes will directly result in less food waste and real business value. 
  What You'll Do  
 
 Own end-to-end design for a web application for corporate users who own the grocery replenishment function, spanning ordering, exceptions, configuration, and performance. 
 Design reporting, insights, and performance dashboards, from table stakes today toward conversational, AI-powered analytics. 
 Design exception-based workflows and controls (ordering, display size, configuration, order policy tuning) that let corporate users manage operations without technical depth. 
 Shape agentic and conversational experiences that surface AI-powered insights to less-technical customers. 
 Own shared portal services UX (admin, permissions, authorization, multi-role) that no single team owns today. 
 Build reusable components and keep UX consistent across portal surfaces. 
 Ship quickly with the Ordering product and engineering teams using modern AI-assisted tools, and partner with design leadership on cross-product coherence. 
 
  Skills and Experience  
 The following represent the skills and experience our ideal candidate possesses. We encourage all highly-qualified candidates to apply, even if they do not fulfill all the listed criteria. 
 
 Senior-level product design experience shipping customer-facing software with measurable outcomes. 
 Deep enterprise SaaS experience, navigating complex systems and multiple tiers of users. 
 Product-minded with engineering overlap, comfortable building directly in code rather than handing off static mockups. We think of this as a "design-focused PM or product-focused designer with engineering depth." 
 Strong systems thinking: reusable patterns and coherent navigation across products and surfaces. 
 Comfort with modern, AI-assisted tooling for exploration, prototyping, and synthesis. Experience with rapidly creating prototypes using generative coding tools. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration across product, engineering, and design. 
 
  Nice-To-Haves  
 
 Experience designing for AI-powered products: conversational interfaces, anomaly detection, and agentic workflows. 
 Experience designing multi-role, permissions-based, or hierarchical enterprise experiences. 
 
   
  This position is not eligible for sponsorship  
  Salary Range in US:  $138K - $187K + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits 
       
  Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh  At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life. 
 
  Comprehensive Health & Wellness:  Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services. 
  Invested in Your Future:  Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match. 
  Flexible & Modern Workspace:  Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access. 
  Growth-Obsessed Culture:  We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh. 
  Holistic Monthly Stipends:  Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive. 
  Time to Recharge:  Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge. 
 
 * Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits  
   
  About Afresh  
 Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales. 
 Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.
